purpose: Teach: 電信/依拠/手がける/内地/買い換え/受取/田舎町/廃業

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 遠隔通信は古くは電信に頼ったって、研修で扱いましたね
lines.en: We covered it in training—how remote communication used to rely on telegraph systems, remember?
lines.style: Thoughtful, drawing on a shared memory. Conversational pace, warm recall. Light emphasis on the training reference, trailing upward slightly as she invites his agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場予測は最新統計に依拠して立てます
lines.en: Right. We base our market forecasts on the latest available statistics.
lines.style: Attentive and affirmative. Steady, professional tone without stiffness. Clear delivery, measured pace. Shows he's following and adding substance to the conversation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 複雑な案件は専門部署が手がけるべきね
lines.en: Complex cases should be handled by the specialist department, don't you think?
lines.style: Directive but not commanding. Measured, thoughtful. Slight upward lilt on the question—inviting his input rather than deciding alone. Professional and considered.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。内地と海外の販売割合を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the domestic and overseas sales ratio.
lines.style: Straightforward progress update. Clear, efficient delivery. Slight emphasis on the completion—'reviewed'—showing initiative. Respectful professional tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社用パソコンの買い換えを進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with replacing the company computers.
lines.style: Collaborative directive. Warm but purposeful. Uses 'let's' genuinely—inviting partnership. Steady pace, clear priority. Not demanding, but decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先からの受取書類を整理しました
lines.en: Understood. I've organized the receipt documents from our business partners.
lines.style: Reliable report. Calm, systematic. Even pace, professional courtesy. Shows preparation and follow-through without overstatement.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 田舎町への配送ルートを最適化しましょう
lines.en: We should optimize our delivery routes to the rural areas.
lines.style: Measured strategic thinking. Slightly slower pace as she works through the logic. Calm, collaborative 'we'—inviting his input on the approach. Professional but open.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。廃業届の事務処理を支援しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm providing administrative support for the business closure filing.
lines.style: Formal, closing-statement delivery. Steady, respectful tone. Slightly increased formality reflects the gravity of the closure process. Clear and composed.
